Karthik/Dev — internal note and suggested artifacts to share with NovaHealth: 

1) EU regions we operate for this customer profile: eu-west-1 (primary), eu-central-1 (secondary). Hosted API data and model KV/cache remain in-region if the tenant is provisioned in those regions.

2) Deployment options (short):
- Hosted (Redwood-managed) in EU: data at rest and KV cache located in EU, logs retained per tenant policy (we can set retention and prevent cross-border exports for logs)
- Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) in customer EU region: suitable if they want predictable throughput + region isolation
- Private (VPC) install: full control of network egress and KMS; recommended if they require on-prem-like isolation or local key material

3) KMS / key management: We support customer-provided KMS via KMIP/HSM integrations for Private and Dedicated. For Hosted, we offer tenant-level keys managed by Redwood KMS with possibility of BYOK via partnered KMS in EU.

4) Cross-border: We can support SCCs and operate under EU SCC framework. For logs/analytics: we can scope data pipelines to keep audit logs in-region; analytics aggregates that leave the EU will be pseudonymized/aggregated unless customer signs off.

5) OFAC/ITAR: We perform screening on contracts and accounts for sanctioned parties. ITAR is generally not applicable to SaaS inference unless the customer is processing controlled technical data — mark as ‘to confirm’ in the SQ.

Artifacts to attach to the next outbound: SOC2 redacted (attached already), short tech note on EU data handling (I’ve drafted a 1-pager), and DPA draft (DPA_renewal_draft.docx). I’ll send the tech note and DPA in the next outbound from Karthik unless you want to review first.

I’ll assign the tech note to Dev to add KMS specifics and confirm exact retention controls.
